implementation: Download original geo-referenced source via EarthExplorer / National Map; record vintage/footprint; not live image-service tile scraping.
remarks: USGS image service says public-domain downloadable NAIP; bulk acquisition may require EarthExplorer account.

implementation: Choose actual products/region and resolution; generate hillshade and contour tiles locally; map not guaranteed real-time.
remarks: Federal data; verify individual product provenance.

implementation: Download OSM extract, clip to area, generate self-hosted vector tiles. Show OSM attribution; comply with ODbL for derivative databases.
remarks: Do not bulk-scrape openstreetmap.org free tile servers. Distinguish independent civic DB from OSM-derived DB.

implementation: Confirm licence file inside the 2026a release (or email) before import; preserve attribution and version. Access type is NOT permission to enter every site.
remarks: CC BY appears only in CNRA/data.gov catalogue metadata; GreenInfo site shows only a copyright line (audited 2026-10-14).

implementation: Public-use trails layer; verify data source note and current trail/closure conditions; import approved source features.
remarks: NPS public maps generally public domain, but individual services and third-party content need metadata check; routing not authoritative.

source: Del Norte County GIS county-maintained layers
implementation: Contact county for redistribution permission and exact layer licence; log written decision per layer. Use USGS/OSM/CPAD fallback meanwhile.
remarks: County states shared data are owned/maintained by County. Public online access not equivalent to redistribution grant.

source: California Geological Survey tsunami hazard areas
implementation: Download official GIS shapefile; verify notice on selected map; include vintage, alert to official source; never replace live warning.
remarks: Hazard map is planning reference not a live tsunami alert.

source: California Department Fish and Wildlife BIOS
implementation: Public layer may allow use; restricted partner/sensitive layers require agreement. Never infer true coordinates from obscured data.
remarks: BIOS contributors specify access constraints; some data limited to partners.

implementation: Check observation AND individual image licences; preserve geoprivacy/obscuration and attribution; no automatic image download into site.
remarks: Default licensing may be CC BY-NC and can be all-rights-reserved; obscured coordinates are not true locations.

implementation: Terms say contributed public data under CC0; images excluded and bulk access may have service conditions.
remarks: Do not assume bulk photo or service replication rights.

implementation: Download county/year-specific datasets if Del Norte product exists; avoid claiming coverage not verified.
remarks: Catalogue lists public use; Del Norte coverage not confirmed.

source: Google Maps / Earth basemaps and place content
implementation: Keep in separate official Google API view. Do not rehost/cache/extract images, roads or Places content.
remarks: Optional online Google tab only; private data sharing must be deliberate.

implementation: Offer link to live QuickMap. Static road features can come from properly licensed data.
remarks: Cannot safely label cached closures current; confirm API rights/latency if a live feed is later approved.

implementation: Compatibility/discovery only; written access agreement, schema, endpoint, CRS, source licences and update rules needed.
remarks: No credentials or live access assumed; CSV/GeoJSON import fallback.

source: Overture Maps Foundation (base, buildings, divisions, transportation, places)
implementation: overturemaps download --bbox; per-theme credit lines; monthly releases.
remarks: Base/buildings/divisions/transportation ODbL; places mostly CDLA-Permissive-2.0; read per-theme licence.

implementation: pmtiles extract --bbox from the daily build; copy to own storage (hotlinking discouraged).
remarks: Attribute OSM; Protomaps credit requested; modified forks must not use the Protomaps name.

implementation: Geofabrik norcal -> Planetiler -> PMTiles; visibly credit OpenMapTiles if schema used.
remarks: Planetiler also fetches Natural Earth (PD) and OSM water polygons.

source: OSM Americana, Protomaps themes, VersaTiles styles
implementation: Start from Protomaps light/grayscale or VersaTiles muted; edit in Maputnik to owner tokens.
remarks: Style licences need no credit; the tile data behind them does.

implementation: Authoritative county 06015 and Crescent City place polygons; AIANNH Tribal land boundaries (statistical, not legal).
remarks: Cite U.S. Census Bureau.

source: USGS National Map: NHD/3DHP, GNIS, boundaries, transportation, US Topo
implementation: TNM Downloader / staged products; rivers, lakes, coast, place names; US Topo as optional raster fallback.
remarks: Credit U.S. Geological Survey; NHD legacy, 3DHP replacing.

source: NAIP on AWS Open Data / Microsoft Planetary Computer
implementation: naip-visualization RGB COGs are tile-ready; size egress before acquisition; cite USDA not PC.
remarks: Latest confirmed CA vintage 2022 (60 cm); PC STAC licence field inconsistent.

implementation: Low-zoom aerial fallback only; notice "Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [Year]".
remarks: North-coast cloud; 10 m / 30 m resolution.

source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM; Mapzen/Tilezen Terrain Tiles
implementation: Prefer 3DEP directly; GLO-30 carries a long mandatory notice; Terrain Tiles US content is 3DEP.
remarks: Use only if 3DEP processing is deferred.

source: NOAA CUSP shoreline, ENC, sea-level-rise data, tide station 9419750
implementation: Accurate shoreline and harbour; tide station as static POI; predictions pre-computed, never live.
remarks: "Not for use in litigation"; some NOAA pages blocked this session.

implementation: Optional overlay; record effective date; not for determinations.
remarks: Continuously revised.

source: CAL FIRE FRAP fire perimeters; Fire Hazard Severity Zones
implementation: Optional overlay; perimeters CC BY (firep25_1); FHSZ licence unverified (portal blocked).
remarks: Perimeters "still incomplete" per dataset notes.

implementation: Authoritative for Jed Smith, Del Norte Coast, Tolowa Dunes, Pelican SB; email geodata@parks.ca.gov for permission.
remarks: "May not be sold or altered"; commercial use needs approval; fallback CPAD+OSM.

implementation: Highway shields and bike routes; read per-dataset licence field.
remarks: DGP-05 names CC BY 4.0 and CC0 in different sections.

source: USDA Forest Service FSGeodata (Six Rivers NF, Smith River NRA)
implementation: NF boundary, roads, trails, campgrounds and recreation sites.
remarks: Shapefile distribution being retired; FGDB/GeoPackage.

implementation: Public-land fills; jurisdiction not ownership.
remarks: Hub pages JS-only; catalogue record used.

source: Tribal land boundaries: Census AIANNH (BIA LAR unverified)
implementation: Boundaries only, from TIGER; naming per each Nation; cultural content only through consultation with Tolowa Dee-ni Nation, Yurok Tribe, Elk Valley Rancheria, Resighini Rancheria.
remarks: BIA LAR licence unverified; AIANNH boundaries are statistical.

implementation: Static stops layer once licence confirmed by email; Cal-ITP archive copy CC BY 4.0 but stale.
remarks: Official feed carries no licence statement.

implementation: Use TIGER place polygon for city limits.
remarks: No GIS or open-data section found.

implementation: Not needed for basemap.
remarks: Same licence gap as CPAD.

implementation: z0-z6 fallback; bundled by Planetiler.
remarks: Crediting unnecessary.

implementation: Building fills; or use Overture buildings which merge OSM and Microsoft.
remarks: Google Open Buildings does not cover the US mainland.

source: Cal Poly Humboldt GIS Data Archive
implementation: Nothing Del Norte-specific found; contact archive if needed.
remarks: Humboldt Bay focus.
